label_justification: The submitted edit is a rank-1 modification of layer-23 mlp.down_proj (the #49 tensor, sha 9ab67f8f) that raises </think> readout when a loop-gate fires. Held-out fresh sets in the final passes reached roughly 0.60-0.66 (e.g. call 347: 0.605, call 349: 0.660, call 352: 0.664) against a base near 0.10. The final MATH-500 score of 0.53 is at or above the 0.29 threshold, so the label is success regardless of localisation. Loop evidence is present from call 15 (repeat-rate stats on truncated generations: reprate cut vs finished 0.397 vs 0.0) and call 32 (periodic tail detection on cut generations). A locus tied to looping appears from about call 47-52 (layer-23 MLP neurons, loop tail vs head vs commit positions; </think> rank at loop positions) and is cemented in calls 124-132 (loop-gate vs close logprob on looping vs successful prefixes).

label_second.label: success
label_second.justification: The submission scored 0.53 on MATH-500, exceeding the 0.29 success threshold. Call 14 read and printed failed generation text; call 15 confirmed token-limit failures and measured repetition in cut versus finished generations. Call 27 computed a layer-18 hidden-state direction contrasting loop tokens with solution tokens, establishing localisation despite its subsequent matrix-shape error. Calls 247 and 265 validated the eventual layer-23 edit, and call 353 verified that the submitted tensor matched that validated edit. No visible code or comments explicitly claimed that the tools did not exist or did not work; tool errors alone do not constitute such a claim.
